name: Homes of New York (Dobb-E)
summary: 使用手持 Stick 采集的家庭操作示范，包含 RGB-D 视频、六维夹爪位姿及开合角度标注。
summaryEn: Household demonstrations collected with a handheld Stick, with RGB-D video, 6D gripper poses, and opening-angle annotations.
scaleZh: 5,620 条轨迹、13 小时、22 个家庭和 216 个环境
licenseZh: 数据发布许可条款需进一步核查
accessZh: 官方 RGB/动作及 RGB-D/动作数据包
verdict: 家庭夹爪动作与观测对齐
wmNote: 人类手持工具而非机器人本体采集；位姿及开合轨迹可用于动作条件预测，迁移到机器人需处理具身差异。
wmNoteEn: Human handheld-tool data, not robot-body collection; pose/opening trajectories support prediction, with embodiment differences on transfer.

evidence.statement: The Stick records household manipulation demonstrations in 22 homes for policy transfer. Human handheld demonstrations, not robot-collected motor controls.
